Goal: split wf into a stable kernel and command groups, with no behaviour change. The kernel is the router, Args and the page lock in src/lib.rs; the shared helpers in src/cmd/mod.rs; the page frame in src/page.rs; and the kind list in src/page/rules/mod.rs. Every page pulls from it and it rarely changes, so forks of work can run in parallel (Matthew t565s2260). Each command group sits on top in its own file, src/cmd/<group>.rs, with its rules in src/page/rules/<group>.rs. Band door: 90.50.10.0400. Acting lead and Prime: Claude (t562u).
Current pass: 05.01, the move. Pack text: labs/0426-plan/PACK-0426-05.01.txt on returns.
Builder: set at pack, one Grok builder (Matthew relays the prompt). Checker: Grok-Check.
Lab: the lab trial tests/lab_0426.rs is written on 90.50.10.0701 by another view after this pass closes. It is not a Done when line of this pass.
Done when: src/cmd.rs is gone, and its code is in src/cmd/mod.rs (shared helpers) and src/cmd/start.rs, plan.rs, build.rs, sync.rs, check.rs, close.rs and lock.rs, as in labs/0426-plan/README.md section 3; the return lists every function's old and new place.
Done when: src/lib.rs keeps only Args, the page lock, writes() and the router; each group's help lines and dispatch live in its own file.
Done when: src/page.rs keeps load, the chain check, the types and the order and apply frame; the kind list and each kind's rules are under src/page/rules/.
Done when: nothing behaves differently: wf help, and a full page loop's log and views, are byte for byte the same as at the start commit, with only times and time-dependent hashes normalised (tests/page_0426.rs).
Done when: every tests/page_*.rs and tests/lab_*.rs from the start commit passes unchanged, and the tests/wf.rs Windows failures are no worse; the return lists each result before and after.
Done when: no file outside the grant changed, and git diff -M shows moved code, not rewritten logic.
Done when: cargo test --lib and cargo test --test page_0426 pass on the box.

band: 90.50.10.0400 (door)
lab: 90.50.10.0701 (trial file tests/lab_0426.rs, written after this pass closes)
needs: 90.50.10.0423 closed and its trial done (it holds src/cmd.rs, src/lib.rs and src/page.rs)
needed by: 90.50.10.0425 (book-prime, Codex); 90.50.10.0422.05.01 to 05.03 (report-system); and every later page on src/cmd.rs, src/lib.rs or src/page.rs (0409, 0406, 0411, 0412)
rule: move only, no behaviour change (t565s2260); one worker per page (t533u); plan labs/0426-plan/ on returns

Planned work for 90.50.10.0426 split-commands. Source: labs/0426-plan/README.md on returns. Decision: Matthew t565s2260 (Nov 23, 3:17 PM EST).

One pass, 05.01, a move only, done by one Grok builder and checked by Grok-Check.
May touch: src/cmd.rs (deleted), src/cmd/, src/lib.rs, src/page.rs, src/page/, tests/page_0426.rs.

Why: nearly every command lives in src/cmd.rs (984 lines at a823ee28), with dispatch in src/lib.rs and every kind's rules in src/page.rs. So 0408, 0423, 0425, 0409, 0406, 0411, 0412 and 0422 all queue for the same files. After the split, a page holds only its own group file and rule file, plus one line in src/lib.rs or src/page/rules/mod.rs when it adds a group or a kind.

Order: 0423 closed and its trial done; then 0426; then 0425 (Codex) and 0422.05.01 (Claude).
Not in this grant: src/render.rs, src/status.rs, src/board.rs, src/log.rs, src/chars.rs, src/git.rs, src/addr.rs, templates, docs and existing tests. Callers keep working through re-exports.
After it closes: Matthew records the new 0422 grant (labs/0422-plan/README.md C9), and Codex writes the 0425 pack against the real layout.
